title: Qualitative evaluation of the habitual external brushing technique and system of parents of young children (2-5 years) and the effectiveness on plaque reduction - A prospective brushing study using a phantom model
summary: The aim of the planned study is to observe the tooth brushing process of parents on the deciduous tooth model (“standardized external brushing”) in a phantom head. In addition, it will be investigated whether and to what extent their own brushing technique and the effectiveness of plaque removal - also known as biofilm or plaque - differs from or is the same as brushing on the plastic milk tooth model.
conditions: Oral health in early childhood – plaque control and caries prevention in children aged 2–5 years

interventions.name:
a) Exploratory video analysis of parents' tooth brushing behavior in young children (2-5 years) and of brushing performed on a phantom model
b) Investigation of plaque reduction capacity during self-brushing and on a phantom model by measuring the amount of plaque present before and after brushing

criteria:
Inclusion criteria:
- Parents with children with first dentition (aged two to five years)
- Use a manual toothbrush for their own oral hygiene (at least once a day)
- Use of a manual toothbrush on the child for external brushing 
- German language skills (for questionnaire)
- Interest and consent to participate in the study
Exclusion criteria:
- Physical or cognitive impairment that impairs tooth brushing
- Removable dentures of the parents
- Fixed orthodontic appliances
- Parents' previous training in one of the dental professions
